hints.title: Columnar Product Accumulation
hints.text: Multiplying two numbers of lengths m and n yields a result of at most length m plus n. Position indices i and j contribute to indices i plus j and i plus j plus one.

hints.title: Positional Product Summation
hints.text: Iterate from right to left across both input strings. Add the product of digits to the sum at position i plus j plus one, updating the carry into position i plus j.

hints.title: Leading Zero Stripping
hints.text: Skip leading zeros in the result array and convert the remaining digits to a string. Return 0 if the product evaluates to zero.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(M * N) time and O(M + N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting directly to big integer types violates problem constraints against direct built-in big integer conversion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating columnar elementary multiplication takes O(M * N) steps and uses an array of size M + N for carry accumulation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should accurately map index pairs (i, j) to (i+j, i+j+1) and strip leading zero placeholders correctly.
